subcategory_text: Integrity checking mechanisms are used to verify hardware integrity.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SI-7(7) (Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity — Hardware Integrity)
implementation_examples: Apply integrity-checking mechanisms to hardware (attested boot, TPM measurements, provenance tags) so unauthorised hardware substitution is detectable
Document the integrity policy for hardware classes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether hardware integrity is verified by mechanism
Determine whether the integrity policy covers device classes
Determine whether integrity is re-verified on hardware changes
Determine whether integrity findings are acted on
